column1: # Random cells of the comparison table, held out: the rules were worked out on comparison.tsv only, see docs/spec/comparison.md.
# Columns: type of a, value of a, type of b, value of b, expected result of comparing a with b.
# Operands are set as in conversion.tsv: a c, n, d or t holds exactly the characters given, padded with blanks; any
# other type gets the given text converted to it (x and xstring as hex digits). The operands are data objects whose
# type is known at run time only (generic parameters); with static types the cells marked
# Expected: < = or >, a compared with b (the operators < <= = <> >= > all agree with it), EXC:<class> for a
# catchable exception, DUMP:<runtime error> for a runtime error that cannot be caught.
